narr: An upper level disturbance moved along a stationary front postioned over northern Pennsylvania during the afternoon. This fueled a large cluster of showers and embedded thunderstorms which pivoted northward into an unstable environment over the Southern Tier of NY. Locally heavy rainfall accompanied the thunderstorms which triggered urban and flash flooding in the Hornell, NY area.
ev: Several roads were flooded in the city with water reported to be near homes.
Many streets were flooded in North Hornell which was holding up traffic.
Roads reported to be flooded near St. James Hospital.
